# Choose how this work runs

Load when a request involves any of these terms: execution mode, inline, subagent, fork, model.

## Step instructions

Decide HOW this work runs and record fact execution_mode (`inline`, `subagent` or
`fork`). Judge the handoff cost, not the diff size: a sub-agent starts from the
brief and nothing else, so work resting on context you already hold gets worse by
being sent away. Weigh COST AND SPEED together — a sub-agent is paid for twice,
once to brief and once to verify, and it runs for minutes where an inline edit you
already understand lands now. Optional — record nothing and it is inferred as
`subagent`.

Also record fact orchestrator_model with the model you are running as, selected from
the configured model ladder. Optional — the escalation ladder uses it to compute retry rungs instead
of hardcoded attempt counts.

## Facts

- `execution_mode`: How this run executes -- "inline", "subagent" or "fork". Declaring it here is what lets the exits below gate on it, and what makes this step a stop rather than something the run settles through.
- `orchestrator_model`: The model this orchestrator is running as, from the rendered {models_list}. Optional — the escalation ladder computes retry rungs from it.
